description:
Port pi-mom as a separate app consuming octo_pi_coder. First non-CLI consumer of the stack — good production validation.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- Slack socket client (choose between `slax`, `slack_elixir`, or hand-rolled over WebSockex).
- Per-channel ChannelQueue GenServer (serialize work per channel; stop commands bypass the queue).
- Agent-per-thread wiring (each Slack thread = one agent session).
- Streaming reply adapter (batch, working indicator, 35K char truncation like upstream).
- Backfill logic on startup.
- Sandbox config (Docker vs host OS).

Definition of done: a running `mix mom` connects to a Slack workspace and processes messages through octo_pi_coder.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.5, §6 Phase 7.
title: Phase 7: octo_pi_mom — Slack bot app
